0x1019CE70.name: Config_LoadDefaultTable
0x1019CE70.evidence: fills 0x29 to 0x48 of this from a constant byte table, overrides some entries when the scene state at g_pSceneState + 8 is 2 or 3, then calls SetConfig for keys 0x6A to 0x89 from that table
0x1019CE70.summary: Loads the default config table for the scene and writes its entries with SetConfig.

0x1019D1C0.name: Config_LoadAltTable
0x1019D1C0.evidence: fills 0x29 to 0x48 of this from a second constant byte table, overrides entries when the scene state at g_pSceneState + 8 is 2 or 3, then calls SetConfig for keys 0x4A to 0x69 from that table
0x1019D1C0.summary: Loads the alternate config table for the scene and writes its entries with SetConfig.

0x1019D8B0.name: Settings_CacheValues

0x1019D8B0.summary: Caches several settings values in the object's fields.

0x1019ED70.name: Text_NextLine
0x1019ED70.evidence: scans for a carriage return or line feed, skips a CR LF or LF pair, and returns the pointer after the line break, or null at the end of the string
0x1019ED70.summary: Returns a pointer to the start of the next line in a text buffer.

0x101A0BE0.name: RecordRing_Push
0x101A0BE0.evidence: copies a 0x124-byte record into the ring at self+4 at index +0x14, copies its string from +8 and its seven dwords from +0x108 to +0x120, advances the head with wrap at the capacity at +8, and increments the count at +0xC
0x101A0BE0.summary: Appends a record to the ring buffer, replacing the oldest slot when it is full.

0x101A0D30.name: RecordRing_FindMatch
0x101A0D30.evidence: walks the ring from +0x10 to +0x14, comparing each record's string at +8 with the argument's and its +0x108 and +0x10C values, and returns 1 when a matching record is found
0x101A0D30.summary: Searches the ring for a record matching the given name and values.

0x101A0F30.name: RecordRing_HasRecords
0x101A0F30.evidence: returns 1 when the count at +0xC is positive, otherwise 0
0x101A0F30.summary: Reports whether the record ring has any records.

0x101A1390.name: DwordRing_Pop
0x101A1390.evidence: when the count at +0x84 is positive, reads the dword at the head index +0x88 plus one, wraps the index at 0x20, and decrements the count
0x101A1390.summary: Removes and returns the oldest dword from a 32-entry ring, or 0 when it is empty.

0x101A1470.name: StrRing_Push
0x101A1470.evidence: copies the 0x54F-byte buffer at +0x9B and the 0x24-byte buffer at +0x5F0 with FUN_103149D0, then copies a string of up to 0x96 bytes into slot +4 and records its length at +0x5EC, increasing the count at +0x614 up to 9
0x101A1470.summary: Stores a string in the next slot of the string ring and counts the stored slots.

0x101A1500.name: StrRing_CopyCurrent
0x101A1500.evidence: copies the current slot's string into param_1 when its length at +0x5EC + index * 4 fits in param_2, otherwise calls FUN_1018FDF0
0x101A1500.summary: Copies the current string slot into the caller's buffer.

0x101A1580.name: StrRing_SetCurrent
0x101A1580.evidence: copies the C string param_1 into the current slot at +0x618 * 0x97 + 4 and stores its length at the slot's entry in +0x5EC when it fits in 0x96 bytes
0x101A1580.summary: Stores a string into the current string slot.

0x101A1660.name: StrRing_Advance
0x101A1660.evidence: increments the index at +0x618 and returns 1 when it is below the count at +0x614, otherwise returns -1
0x101A1660.summary: Moves the string ring's current index forward.

0x101A1690.name: StrRing_Retreat
0x101A1690.evidence: decrements the index at +0x618 and returns 1 when it was positive, otherwise returns -1
0x101A1690.summary: Moves the string ring's current index back.
